A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same SynGR study with complete, readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–D. All 15 pages were compared; differences are confined to the version stamp and minor Figure 6 edits.

before.justification: v1 reports original recommendation results on Arts, Games, and Instruments in Table 1, plus efficiency measurements, ablations, sensitivity experiments, and a qualitative case study.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons and additional sensitivity results in Appendix D.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same RQ-VAE tokenization, saliency-aware masking, synergistic contrastive learning, generative objectives, and beam-search inference. No algorithm or model component changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate on Arts, Games, and Instruments and use the same six Amazon categories for pretraining in Appendix C/Table 3. The labeled case-study scenario also remains unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same 12 baselines, including GRU4Rec, VQ-Rec, MQL4GRec, and MACRec. The efficiency and qualitative comparisons continue to use MACRec.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendix C retain the same leave-one-out protocol, full-item ranking, evaluation metrics, beam size of 20, model configurations, and 200-epoch training budget. No revised experimental procedure is reported.

E4.justification: The efficiency analysis, three ablation variants, parameter sweeps, and Appendix D sensitivity analyses are unchanged. Figure 6 replaces a thumbnail while retaining the same case-study question, labeled items, and recommendation rankings.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty estimates for the experimental results. Statistical reporting practices remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical results and reported findings match throughout. For example, Table 1 retains SynGR HR@10 values of 0.1449, 0.1092, and 0.1768 for Arts, Games, and Instruments; Figure 6 still ranks the ground-truth item first for SynGR and third for MACRec.

T1.justification: The PID formulation, Definition 1, Lemma 1, its proof in Appendix A, and the normalized PID computation in Algorithm 1 are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about the synergy gap, suppression of unimodal shortcuts, and improved recommendation performance, including approximately 10% average gains.

C2.justification: The explanations of modality dominance, experimental findings, and case-study rankings are unchanged. Both versions retain the limitations concerning collaborative signals and additional modalities, and Appendix A's qualification of the theoretical result as an inductive-bias characterization.

D1.justification: Appendix C retains the same architecture, feature encoders, quantization settings, optimizer, hyperparameter ranges, and training budget. Hardware information and the code-access link also remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, related-work discussion, and positioning against alignment-based multimodal recommendation are unchanged.

P1.justification: The arXiv margin stamp changes from v1 dated 18 May 2026 to v2 dated 19 Jul 2026. Article prose, headings, authors, section order, and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 6 replaces the football thumbnail in both user-history rows with an image bearing Qatar 2022 markings and slightly repositions the 'GT Ranked #1' label. The arXiv margin stamp also moves; other figures, tables, captions, and page layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The replacement football image makes Figure 6's 2022 context more explicit, but preserves its evidence and interpretation. This small visual refinement and the updated version stamp leave the scientific arguments, empirical support, reproducibility information, and appendices unchanged, with no meaningful overall quality difference.
